input.question: When was Cedar Creek High School established?

documents.text: Cedar Creek High School (New Jersey) Cedar Creek High School is a public high school in Egg Harbor City, Atlantic County, New Jersey, United States. The school serves students in ninth through twelfth grades as part of the Greater Egg Harbor Regional High School District and opened in September 2010. The school's colors are forest green, maroon/burgundy and cream. The school mascot is the pirate. As of the 2015-16 school year, the school had an enrollment of 921 students and 70.0 classroom teachers (on an FTE basis), for a student–teacher ratio of 13.2:1. There were 317 students (34.4% of enrollment)
